Theorem
[Homogeneous-space proportionality] \group smearing Source: thurston:page-0141, thurston:page-0142

Let $G$ act transitively on $X$ with compact isotropy groups, and choose an invariant volume form. There is a constant $C$ such that every closed oriented $(G,X)$-manifold $M$ satisfies \[ \| [M]\| =Cv(M). \] If $\alpha \in H_G^*(X)$ is invariant cohomology and $\alpha _M$ is its induced class on $M$, a norm can be chosen on $H_G^*(X)$ so that \[ \| \operatorname {PD}(\alpha _M)\| =v(M)\| \alpha \| . \]
